shorts_extract.hook: Why do you end up hating your own choice only when you are allowed to swap it later?
shorts_extract.core_experiment: Harvard psychologists had students print two favorite photos and pick one — either permanently or with five days to swap — and the swap group liked their photo significantly less.
shorts_extract.twist: An open exit keeps your anterior cingulate conflict alarm nitpicking flaws, whereas locking the door wakes your prefrontal satisfaction builder.
